assets.scope: deep-bellow and maze corrupted-horror pools (general/npcs/horror-corrupted.lua:118, horror/corrupted, non-unique, no define_as, rank 2, base BASE_NPC_CORRUPTED_HORROR, default-name image); single definition; its make_escort lists drem and dremling by name, so nothing else is built as a drem master

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.

Native shape (64x64): a stocky dwarf-like figure in brown mail with a pale faceless head and a raised fist. Keep the pale faceless sewn-mouth head and the raised commanding fist, in lighter patched steel-blue mail.

Five shipped horror tokens (small thin pink dredgling crouched on all fours, dark-brown armoured drem with axe and shield, grey-white shaggy dremling, tan-pink many-armed weirdling beast, horned horror with a bull head and tentacles): none of the three new horrors may be any of these.

prompt_fields.subject: A drem master seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a stocky dwarf-proportioned corrupted commander with a PALE BONE-GREY faceless head, a stitched-shut mouth and no eyes, wearing patched-together DENTED but PALE POLISHED STEEL mail armour with orange RUST patches and a ragged BONE-WHITE cloth sash and tabard, ONE FIST RAISED HIGH IN COMMAND beside the head and the other hand holding a chipped waraxe pointing down and forward, short thick legs planted wide. Stocky, grim, lopsided and complete; everything stays inside the disc.
prompt_fields.contrast: Horrors: the DREM MASTER is the LIGHT STEEL-BLUE ARMOURED COMMANDER with one fist raised (silhouette: a stocky figure with one arm raised above the head and an axe pointing down on the other side; hue: pale grey face, steel-blue-grey mail, orange rust patches; value: mid-light). The shipped drem is a dark brown armoured dwarfish figure with a round shield, the dremling a grey-white shaggy hunched creature, the dredgling a thin pink crouching creature: this must not be brown, must not carry a shield and must not be shaggy. The other new horrors are a huge salmon-pink knuckle-walker (dredge) and a cream-white floating bloated pear (bloated horror).
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker (the style reference's own brightness). No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. The ENTIRE creature, every limb, tail, wing, drip, staff and effect included, fits inside a circle of about three quarters of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side, yet the creature is large and bold inside that circle. Draw the creature COMPACT and chunky: limbs, weapons, tools, cloth and effects are pulled in so the whole silhouette forms one rounded mass inside the inner three quarters of the disc; no tip, blade, hat brim, tentacle end or tail reaches the outer sixth ring band or crosses the disc rim. Value discipline (measured lesson from earlier tokens): the creature's large masses are MID-LIGHT to LIGHT in value, clearly LIGHTER than the charcoal disc, with broad pale highlight planes on every upper-left surface, so the silhouette reads as a bright shape on the dark disc at very small size. Nothing near-black except tiny eye slits and thin seams; no black cloth, black leather, black armour or black fur anywhere. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: the design and pose were right, but the dark grey-blue mail read as a DARK mass against the dark disc at very small size and the fist reached near the rim. This time keep the same stocky faceless stitched-mouth commander with one fist raised in command and a chipped waraxe pointing down, but paint the armour in a clearly LIGHTER value range: PALE POLISHED STEEL plates with broad near-white highlight planes on every upper-left surface, BONE-WHITE ragged cloth sash and tabard, a pale bone-grey head, bright ORANGE rust patches kept as small accents, and a STRONG LIGHT RIM (bright silver-white edge light) along the entire outline of the figure, so it reads as a light shape on the dark disc; only the mail links and joint seams stay mid-grey. Draw the figure a little SMALLER: the whole figure, raised fist and axe included, inside a circle of about two thirds of the disc radius with a wide bare ring of plate all round. Render the WHOLE disc, its outer ring band and the plate under the figure, at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker, evenly all round, with NO cast shadow and no ambient darkening of the disc from the creature. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: the figure was exactly right (pale polished steel armour with near-white highlights, bone-white ragged cloth, pale bone-grey stitched head, one fist raised, chipped axe pointing down, orange rust accents, light rim, about two thirds of the disc radius) and must be kept unchanged, but the DISC PLATE came out clearly DARKER than the style reference all the way round, including the outer ring band. This time render the entire disc plate, the flat charcoal-brown plate under and around the figure and the whole outer ring band with its copper-grey bevel, VISIBLY LIGHTER than in the previous attempt: match the style reference's plate brightness exactly, erring a little lighter, evenly all round, warm-neutral mid charcoal (not near-black), with NO cast shadow, no contact shadow, no vignette and no ambient darkening under or around the figure.
prompt_fields.palette: Pale grey skin and cloth, dented steel-blue-grey mail in a mid-light value with pale highlight planes, orange rust patches, a chipped pale-steel axe head; nothing darker than dark steel-blue except thin seams and the stitched mouth; the disc stays neutral charcoal at reference lightness and the mail must not merge with it. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.

assets.gate_reason: Exact source identity re-verified directly against game/modules/tome source (name=drem master, define_as=None, type=horror/subtype=corrupted, unique=False, native_tall=False); details and hashes in evidence/monster-batch-v-20260930/source-contracts.json. base BASE_NPC_CORRUPTED_HORROR (horror/corrupted, no image=, no shader); NPC.lua:33 default-name image (npc/<type>_<subtype>_<name>.png) is the only image source: no image=, nice_tile, add_mos, moddable_tile, shader, anim or add_displays on the leaf or base; generic actor.image==entry.image single path; native sprite 64x64; resolvers.equip fills inventory slots only (no moddable_tile, so no display change) (waraxe, shield, heavy armour); talents Dwarf Resilience, Dredge Frenzy, Dominate (all activated); resolvers.sustains_at_birth() on the leaf but no sustained talent known, so nothing starts; no auto_classes. Exact catalog entry only, never a whole-subtype mapping.
